mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT i.inspection_id AS inspectionId, i.submitted_at AS submittedAt, i.result AS result, i.facility_id AS facilityId, f.domain AS domain, f.name AS facilityName, f.floor AS floor, f.zone AS zone, i.inspector_id AS inspectorId, ip.name AS inspectorName FROM inspections i JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = i.facility_id LEFT JOIN inspector_profile ip ON ip.inspector_id = i.inspector_id ORDER BY i.submitted_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
